subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): skip IMDS during credential auto-detection (#64891)

question: Should this PR be held for live EC2/ECS/default-chain and non-AWS sandbox proof before merge, or is the current no-signal live output plus source/unit coverage sufficient?
rationale: The code shape now looks focused, but the remaining uncertainty is an auth-provider compatibility and external-API proof bar that automation cannot settle from the contributor's local environment alone.

options.title: Require live default-chain proof
options.body: Run or request maintainer/live proof that explicit Bedrock EC2/ECS/default-chain credentials still resolve and the no-signal sandbox path no longer emits IMDS traffic before merge.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: Merge after CI if maintainers accept that unit coverage and copied live output for the no-signal path are enough despite missing live AWS and sandbox proof.

options.title: Reject explicit-only IMDS boundary
options.body: Pause the PR and ask for a different compatibility design if implicit EC2 instance-role auto-detection must remain available without explicit Bedrock memory configuration.

recommendation.title: Require live default-chain proof
recommendation.body: Run or request maintainer/live proof that explicit Bedrock EC2/ECS/default-chain credentials still resolve and the no-signal sandbox path no longer emits IMDS traffic before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the current memory-plugin adapter boundary and prior merged Bedrock credential-gate work.
